title: Official I-009 random undo/hash coverage of admitted clip gain commands
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of path-sorted sha256sum output in "digest  path\n" form (sort by path)
bounds: This slice adds official coverage only for the recorded Increment 2.02/2.06 gap that admitted SetClipGain / SetGainKeyframe / RemoveGainKeyframe were not in a random undo generator. It does not open new audio capabilities and does not change production algebra.

A new official document file, not a rewrite of Increment 1.88 / I-005 or of the frozen 2.02 / 2.06 gain tests, generates those three admitted commands. 1000 seeded sequences (seed 0x2090a009) walked immutable restoreSnapshot snapshots back to the start content hash. Legal draws actually included all three families (setClipGain=907, setGainKeyframe=1808, removeGainKeyframe=730; legal=3445, refusals=337). Refusals do not half-write. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. No Slip/Roll/Slide or gain field-level invert was added.

Independent audio import, bus Effect/limiter, I-060/V-024, I-007 remapping/nest, new-track, Pulse/clock/queue, invert-matrix rows, caption export, cross-device/RTC, and store schema v10 are not opened. Store tests and the Increment 1.88 SDK 1000-sequence undo suite were not run and are not part of this official new-count. I-009 stays partial. Increment 1.17/1.18 stay open. I-023 stays partial.
